events.title: Den české státnosti (St. Wenceslas Day)
events.note: A national holiday honoring the patron saint of the Czech Republic, St. Wenceslas, celebrated with various cultural and historical events across the country.
events.marketing_angle: Celebrate Czech heritage and national pride with festive events and traditions.
events.why_selected: As a major national holiday, it holds significant cultural importance and offers opportunities for community engagement and national pride.

events.title: Formula 1 Japanese Grand Prix
events.note: The Japanese Grand Prix, a key race in the Formula 1 calendar, featuring high-speed action and strategic battles on the Suzuka Circuit.
events.marketing_angle: Witness the excitement of Formula 1 racing at the iconic Suzuka Circuit in Japan.
events.why_selected: Formula 1 events attract a global audience, and the Japanese Grand Prix is known for its challenging track and competitive racing.

events.title: MotoGP Australian Grand Prix
events.note: The Australian Grand Prix, a thrilling MotoGP race held at the Phillip Island Circuit, known for its fast corners and scenic views.
events.marketing_angle: Experience the adrenaline of MotoGP racing at the picturesque Phillip Island Circuit in Australia.
events.why_selected: MotoGP races are popular among motorsport enthusiasts, and the Australian Grand Prix offers exciting racing action.

events.title: HC Sparta Praha vs. HC Energie Karlovy Vary
events.note: A highly anticipated ice hockey match between two top Czech teams, taking place at the O2 arena in Prague.
events.marketing_angle: Experience the thrill of Czech ice hockey at its finest with this exciting matchup.
events.why_selected: Ice hockey is a beloved sport in the Czech Republic, and this game features prominent local teams, attracting significant fan interest.

events.title: HC Sparta Praha vs. Motor České Budějovice
events.note: Another exciting ice hockey game featuring HC Sparta Praha, this time against Motor České Budějovice, promising high-paced action.
events.marketing_angle: Don't miss the action as HC Sparta Praha takes on Motor České Budějovice in this thrilling ice hockey encounter.
events.why_selected: Continued coverage of HC Sparta Praha's games maintains audience engagement and highlights the team's performance.
